name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd

business.about: Incorporated in 2008, Kaynes Technology is a leading end-to-end and IoT solutions-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing company. The company provides conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support for major players in the automotive, industrial, aerospace and defense, outer-space, nuclear, medical, railways, Internet of Things ("IoT"), Information Technology ("IT") and other segments. [1]
business.key_points: Business Offerings: [1] The company is a leading provider of end -to-end IoT-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing services (IEMS). It offers a full spectrum of services across the entire electronics value chain, spanning conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support. [2] It has also ventured into Smart Metering, Advanced Semiconductor Packaging (OSAT), High-Density Interconnect PCBs, and AI-Powered Railway Safety. [3]
